description: This shell script defines a performance testing procedure for Git repositories, specifically testing the performance of tag-following with many tags. It sets up repositories, creates complex histories, tags, and packs, then runs fetch operations to measure performance.

methods.name: create_history
methods.description: Constructs a commit history with a specified number of commits on a given branch, each referencing a given blob.

methods.name: create_tags
methods.description: Creates tags for each commit in the provided revision list.
